question: As of February 2023, how many times Aditi Ashok has overall won the LET (Ladies European Tour) title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Four**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aditi Ashok** is an Indian professional **golfer** who started playing golf at the age of **five.**
 
• She turned professional in** 2016 **and joined the** Ladies European Tour** (LET) in the same year.
 
• Aditi Ashok has also played on the LPGA Tour and has represented India in the **Olympics.**
 
• As of February 2023, Aditi Ashok has overall won the LET **four times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Founded in **1978,** the Ladies European Tour is a professional** golf tour for women.**
 
• It is situated in **England **at the Buckinghamshire Golf Club, close to London.
 
• Members of the tour made the decision to establish the** Women Professional Golfers' European Tour Limited** as a separate company in **1988.**
